about: Golden cases for evals/run.py. Default dataset: production day 2026-09-14, shift 2, selected-shift scope, Period control on Day (a case may set period: week|month|fiscal). A routing case records expect.url, the canonical address its question resolves to (issue #20); every offline case also runs through GET /q and that address. Every case also passes the global invariants in run.py (offline is $0, every number traces to a tool row, chart rows equal their source, evidence stays inside scope, citations resolve, tables are complete). The value cases live in golden_values.json, generated by make_value_goldens.py. A case with live: true also runs against a live planner under --live (or replays its recorded fixture); expect_live replaces expect for that run.
